purpose: Acquire a prevalidated executable Stage-C task distribution independently from candidate training-corpus acquisition.

task_class_e2_contracts.repository_patch: the same frozen isolated command passes on both parent and merge commits
task_class_e2_contracts.function_generation: the frozen isolated evaluator, dependency image, public tests, and hidden tests pass on the reference solution and the evaluator rejects at least one frozen negative control
task_class_e2_contracts.other: requires a separately frozen task-class-specific reproducibility contract

splits.development: may support candidate selection and stopping rules
splits.confirmatory: untouched until the development decision and all margins are frozen

sample_size_rule.primary_estimand: paired per-task curated-minus-common-Stage-A-random executable success difference
required_before_development_model_outcom: compute a task-count requirement from the practical margin and desired confidence-interval precision
document the expected floor-effect and abstention rule

primary_comparison: curated_equal_token versus the same common disjoint Stage-A-random baseline used by every sensitivity arm
supporting_comparisons: raw_random_equal_token versus the same common disjoint Stage-A-random baseline
forbidden_uses: using task outcomes in Stage B
using execution-support tier in Stage B
training on task prompts, tests, patches, or solutions
selecting or tuning the harness from model outcomes
inspecting confirmatory outcomes before the development decision is frozen
using different Stage-A baselines for sensitivity arms
human_or_llm_review: optional diagnostic only; never task ground truth, tuning signal, or entry gate
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Executable-task harness acquisition contract only; no Utility, curation-benefit, or release claim.
